comment: Spec 087 S3 conversion PR-C (families F4 + F5) fixture outputs, captured from the pre-conversion implementations on branch feat/087-s3-conv-c BEFORE any implementation changed. Inputs are synthetic records in the mesopotamian_contact data module's shapes (the archive graphs' real source files are absent from this repo — corpora/ is a gitignored download tree and the loaders raise FileNotFoundError — so the archive graphs' inputs are reproduced in shape, sized to exercise every branch; see the capture script in the PR record for the branch map). All cases are full-mode canonical-JSON pins; permutation outputs are seed-determined, so byte-equality is exact.

Bayesian decoder: observed total weight = 7.700 across 8 inscribed seals. Null mean = 6.439 (1000 permutations of confidence assignments). Global p-value = 0.1330. Lower p = signs assigned to high-confidence phonemes really do cluster on the inscribed-seal corpus more than chance.
expected.interpretation: Caveat: this null-permutation strategy keeps the multiset of confidence labels constant but breaks their assignment to specific sign IDs. A significant p means the observed map places high-confidence phonemes on more 'frequent' signs in our corpus than chance would predict. This is a NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT condition for the Dravidian hypothesis -- it only validates that Parpola's high-confidence proposals land on the right SIGNS, not that those phoneme VALUES are correct.

Bayesian decoder v2 (phoneme-VALUE permutation): observed total weighted score = 16.300 across 8 inscribed seals. Null mean = 11.203 (1000 value permutations). Global p-value = 0.0330. Lower p = the SPECIFIC Dravidian phoneme values that Parpola assigns to specific sign IDs produce more plausible compound names than chance value-assignments would.
expected.interpretation: This extends Phase-26b: instead of permuting just confidence labels, we permute the actual Dravidian phoneme VALUES (miin, aru-, eZu-, vaTa-, muruku, etc.) across sign IDs. Significant p would mean Parpola's specific value-assignments produce more Dravidian-plausible compounds (aru-miin = Pleiades, vaTa-miin = north star, etc.) than randomized value-assignments. As with Phase-26b, this test is currently data-starved (1/11 readable seals) and will only become informative after CISI Vol 3 plate ingestion (Phase-28+).
